The filmmaker explores the intense world of child beauty pageants, shedding light on the extreme measures driven by the ambitions of parents and societal expectations.
Josh Lambert and his estranged college-aged son attempt to put their demons to rest once and for all by going deep into the Further and tackling a new host of demons.
Lucian, a werewolf slave, convinces his Lycan compatriots to rebel against their vampire masters, who are led by Viktor, a powerful vampire elder. This leads to a full-fledged war between the two.
Single father David Kim learns that his daughter, Margot, has gone missing. Desperate to do something, he checks Margot's laptop and finds clues and hidden truths.
Former martial arts titleholder prepares to return to familiar fields and uses his traditional fighting skills against the new line of fighters in order to reclaim his position.
Joseph Cooper leads a mission through a wormhole to find a habitable planet. With Dr Brand's help, he makes tough choices to save humanity.

Action Horror with Wesley Snipes and Stephen Dorff. Half human, Half vampire Blade and his mentor Whistler battle an evil vampire rebel who plans to take over the vampire council and resurrect voracious blood god La Magra.
Selene, a vampire warrior, finds out that the humans have decided to eradicate her clan and leads a battle, along with another vampire and a young girl, against them.
Alice, along with her allies, returns to Raccoon City to attack The Hive and stop the Umbrella Corporation from unleashing its final strike on the last remaining survivors of the apocalypse.
An average family is thrust into the spotlight after the father commits a seeming self-defense murder at his diner.
A San Francisco cartoonist transforms into an amateur sleuth consumed by the hunt for a Killer. Soon, this unknown figure spreads fear across Northern California through a series of brutal murders.
Haunted by a past misjudgment, smokejumper Hannah Faber puts her life on the line to protect a boy from a raging wildfire and the assassins who killed his father.

A man's (Jim Carrey) discovery of an obscure book about the number 23 leads him on a descent into darkness. As he becomes more obsessed with its contents, he becomes more convinced that it is, in fact, based on his life. To his horror, he discovers grave consequences in store for the book's main character.
Captain Chesley, a commercial pilot, makes an emergency landing on the Hudson River after his plane gets hit by birds. However, an investigation into the matter might prove to be fatal to his career.

Selene, a vampire warrior, finds out that the humans have decided to eradicate her clan and leads a battle, along with another vampire and a young girl, against them.
As the Umbrella Corporation's T-virus continues to turn humans into zombies, Alice awakens in a secret prison. With the help of friends old and new, she tries to escape and save humanity.
Selene, an elite vampire assassin with very few allies on her side, tries to end a long-running war between the clan that betrayed her and the Lycans.

On an outer space mission, engineer Ryan Stone and astronaut Matt Kowalski are hit by high-speed space debris. As the situation gets dire, Stone rises to the occasion as a survivor.
In a dystopian future, Nick and Emily operate a machine that can make people relive memories. However, a new client's request turns their lives upside down.

It's the Roaring `20s and Prohibition hasn't stopped the flow of booze in an underground network of gangster-run speakeasies. The opportunity to gain power and money is there for any man with enough ambition and nerve, and Joe Coughlin, the son of the Boston Police superintendent, long ago turned his back on his strict upbringing for the spoils of being an outlaw. But even among criminals there are rules, and Joe breaks a big one: crossing a powerful mob boss by stealing his money and his moll.
A Brooklyn mobster and prolific hit man must choose between the crime family he serves and the real family he abandoned long ago, when his estranged son becomes a target.
A cave-in leaves 33 miners trapped three miles underground. As the world watches on, rescue teams work tirelessly to save the seemingly doomed crew.
Joseph Cooper leads a mission through a wormhole to find a habitable planet. With Dr Brand's help, he makes tough choices to save humanity.

Selene, an elite vampire assassin with very few allies on her side, tries to end a long-running war between the clan that betrayed her and the Lycans.
When Jim's hypersleep pod malfunctions, he wakes up alone on a doomed ship. Later, he teams up with a fellow passenger, and they race against time to stop a looming disaster before it's too late.
The Angels track down rings containing the names of those in the FBI's witness protection programme. However, the witnesses begin to get murdered one by one.

Two-bit crook Harry Lockhart (Robert Downey Jr.) stumbles into an audition for a mystery film while on the run from the cops. Winning the part, he lands in Hollywood, where he's flung into a tangled, murderous conspiracy with his childhood sweetheart, Harmony Lane (Michelle Monaghan), and hard-boiled private eye Perry van Shrike (Val Kilmer). This deadpan, affectionate parody of film noir tropes is named for film critic Pauline Kael's influential 1968 collection of film reviews and essays.

It's "War of the Worlds" all over again when George accidentally misreads a school news headline and announces that Upper Redwood High has been invaded by aliens. The student body panics when they hear the news.
The world plunges into panic as doctors globally race against time to find a cure for a lethal virus outbreak decimating the infected population.
Dan Torrance fights to find a semblance of peace after his traumatic childhood. His life changes when he meets Abra, a courageous teenager with a powerful extrasensory gift.

(2009) Nelson Mandela, in his first term as the South African President, initiates a unique venture to unite the apartheid-torn land: enlist the national rugby team on a mission to win the 1995 Rugby World Cup. PG-13 $4.99.
